item.tib: gsang sngags las kyi kha tshar sreg byed me lha'i bskul pa
item.coloph: gsang sngags thams cad kyi kha tshar/ bsnyen sgrab las kyi mdel thung / phrin las myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul/ 'byung ba dbang du 'dus pa'i rgyal po/ bya sla khyer bde 'dod pa kun 'grub kyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ gshen gsang ba 'dus pas gsang sngags yongs kyi kha tshar du mdzad nas/ rim par brgyud nas mkha' 'gro nyi ma 'od 'bar gyis rnal 'byor kun dga' tshul khrims la brgyud pa'o//
